messages:
Rina Kapoor: Quick flag 50% drop in active seats for Meridian after onboarding week. Renewal in 21 days. Suggest a 'rapid retention sprint' play to triage and try to recover. Anyone own a short template for this?

Theo Barnes: Oof. Which feature area? Logs show most calls hang during bulk embedding runs.

Jules Park: From onboarding notes: customer reported unclear docs around streaming vs batch and tried large batch retries. They said it felt 'chatty' and hard to debug.

Hannah Li: Telemetry: increased client retries + elevated token spend due to duplicate jobs. No server 5xx, but SLO latency breaches at peak.

Rina Kapoor: Proposed sprint (quick): 1) 20-min triage call w/ PM + infra 2) one-click safety config (limit batch concurrency + enable prefix caching) 3) 30-min targeted enablement demo + runbook walk-through 4) 72-hr monitoring window 5) renewal note if no lift. Owner: @Jules.

Theo Barnes: Add explicit rollback/downgrade option: temporary "throttle bridge" plan (keeps current model version + audits, reduces concurrency & token rate) for up to 30 days. Keep it reversible with one API call.

Jules Park: I'll own outreach and meeting. Draft invite: "Hi {{name}}, we saw activity dip and would like to run a quick 20-min triage + small config change that often fixes this. Available tomorrow 9am PT?"

Hannah Li: Quick mitigation config I can apply org-scoped: ```json
{"org_id":"meridian","max_concurrency":2,"enable_prefix_cache":true,"max_file_mb":6}
``` Will monitor token delta and error rate.

Rina Kapoor: Nice. Can someone produce a 1-paragraph summary for the renewal rep that explains the intervention and what's reversible? Keep it <5 bullets.

Theo Barnes: I'll do the 1-paragraph + bullets: cause, temporary fixes, rollback terms, success criteria (retry rate <5%, token spend normalized, WAU +20% in 7 days).

alert-bot: Created ticket CS-9011 (Meridian activation). Priority: P3. Assigned: Hannah Li.

Jules Park: After the call we'll capture two things in-thread: (1) whether prefix caching was previously enabled (2) any docs gaps they cite. We'll add both to the playbook entry under tag: retention-sprint.

Hannah Li: Pushed config to staging; smoke tests show reduced retries in synthetic import. Ready to push to prod after triage call.

Rina Kapoor: Timeline: triage tomorrow 9am PT, prod safety config within 2 hours after call if agreed, 72-hr monitoring window, renewal alert to rep 7 days before renewal.

Theo Barnes: If they request to cut seats we'll offer the throttle-bridge for 30 days + 2-week re-eval so we avoid immediate churn. Documented pricing offset and feature parity.

Jules Park: Meeting scheduled. I'll paste meeting notes and a short customer quote here after.

Hannah Li: Will post prod metrics (pre/post) and token usage delta once config promoted.

Rina Kapoor: Thanks team. If this works we'll create a compact template (invite, config snippet, notes checklist) and add to CS play library for quick reuse. :sparkles:
